value.name: compares caseworker notes with envelope record
value.description: Asha compares the caseworker's shorthand notes with the envelope from the door pocket and the clerk's number, marking each minute until the sequence becomes clear.
evidence: she set the envelope from the door pocket beside them and unfolded it so the ballpoint number from the clerk sat next to the stamp on Devin's page, and she went through them line by line, marking each minute in the margin of the pad with a small tick until she had three ticks she could not rearrange

value.name: realizes correction happened after standing
value.description: Asha realizes the correction was processed after she stood up, meaning the caseworker answered questions before the court had the record.
evidence: the sequence on the desk was the sequence she had been afraid it would be: the correction had gone through after she had stood up, not before, and the caseworker had answered her questions on a record the court did not yet have

value.name: pauses in distress
value.description: Asha closes the pad over the pen and sits motionless for a while, absorbing the implication of what she has found.
evidence: She closed the pad over the pen to keep her place and did not move for a while

value.name: opens Devin thread
value.description: Asha takes out her phone and opens her message thread with Devin.
evidence: Asha reached into the briefcase for her phone, opened the thread with Devin

value.name: deletes unsent drafts
value.description: She deletes the unsent draft messages from the car, including the one asking Devin about Monday afternoon.
evidence: held her thumb over the half-written drafts she had not sent from the car
She deleted them one at a time, the older ones first, and then the most recent, where she had asked him whether he remembered the order of things on Monday afternoon

value.name: stows phone and briefcase
value.description: Asha puts the phone down, closes the briefcase over the printouts, and locks it shut.
evidence: She set the phone face down on the corner of the desk beside the pad, closed the briefcase over the printouts, and pressed the latch until it clicked

value.name: hesitates before leaving
value.description: The loud click of the latch makes Asha linger with her hand on the briefcase, avoiding the page beneath it.
evidence: The sound was louder than she expected in the quiet of the study, and she left her hand on the leather a moment longer than the motion required, looking at the small brass tongue of the lock rather than at the page underneath

value.name: realizes she must confront what comes next
value.description: Asha finally understands that she will have to walk into whatever follows, accepting the consequence of her discovery.
evidence: When she finally drew her hand back, she understood that she would walk into
